title: Concrete Pump for House and Rural Building Pours
seoTitle: Concrete Pump for House & Rural Building | Pinjin
description: House pours on the Xingtai table: Electric 15 (8–10 m³/h, 15–20 m vertical, 450 kg), Tractor-Driven 4100 (6–12 m³/h), rural diesel (5–8 m³/h, 17 kW). Not Electric 80. Alibaba’s 30–60 m³/h house FAQ is not a Pinjin row.

answerBlock.what: A house or rural building pump at Pinjin is a compact trailer matched to a short pipe and small stone — not a 60 m³/h HBT. Electric 15 lists 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 15–20 m vertical / 60–80 m horizontal, 1–3 cm stone, 450 kg. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, 40–100 m / 15–45 m, 1300 kg. Rural diesel lists 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, 30–50 m / 10–30 m, 800 kg. Mixer pump (21 m³/h) is for sites that mix and pump on one trailer.
answerBlock.who: Self-builders and small contractors pouring 2–3 floor houses, courtyards or village roads who can state power, gate width and max stone.
factors: Grid 15 kW vs tractor PTO vs 17 kW diesel
Vertical metres (Electric 15 is 15–20 m, not a high-rise row)
Trailer weight through the gate (450 kg / 800 kg / 1300 kg)
Do not use Alibaba’s 30–60 m³/h house FAQ as a Pinjin spec

faqs.question: What size pump do I need for a single-family home?
faqs.answer: Alibaba’s buying-guide FAQ cites a trailer or mini pump at 30–60 m³/h. Pinjin house rows are smaller: Electric 15 8–10 m³/h, Tractor-Driven 4100 6–12 m³/h, rural diesel 5–8 m³/h. Match stone, pipe and access to those printed rows. Diesel 50 at 30 m³/h is a different, heavier trailer (3300 kg).

faqs.question: Electric 15, tractor 4100 or rural diesel — which house pump?
faqs.answer: Grid and a 450 kg frame that fits 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm → Electric 15. Tractor on site, 6–12 m³/h, 40–100 m / 15–45 m → 4100. No grid and no tractor, 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m / 10–30 m, 800 kg → rural diesel. None of these is Electric 80.

faqs.question: Is a 2–3 floor self-built house inside Electric 15 vertical height?
faqs.answer: Electric 15 lists 15–20 m vertical. A two- to three-storey house at about 3 m per floor can sit in that band if the pipe run is short and stone stays 1–3 cm. We still want your measured height and horizontal pipe — we do not convert storeys for you without those metres.
